ai_productivity.title: ⚡ AI & Productivity
ai_productivity.content:
• **Anthropic:** Claude 4 Opus has shipped with a 2M token context window and a benchmark MMLU score of 91.2%. It is 2x faster than Claude 3.5 Opus and priced at $10/1M input and $30/1M output tokens. This allows a developer to upload an entire enterprise codebase and perform a comprehensive security audit in a single prompt without needing RAG. Anthropic Blog.

• **OpenAI:** GPT-5-Turbo is now live, featuring native omnimodal temporal reasoning and a 512k context window. It achieves a 94% score on HumanEval and generates text at 150 tokens/sec, significantly outperforming GPT-4o in complex logic. A knowledge worker can now record a 10-minute screen share of a software bug and receive a fully implemented pull request fix instantly. OpenAI Blog.

• **Notion:** Notion AI OS 2.0 has launched, introducing autonomous "Workspace Agents" that can read and write across all pages independently. Unlike the previous assistant, it can now autonomously design project architectures and sync tasks across separate databases. This replaces the manual process of setting up project boards and linking pages by generating the entire workspace structure from a single voice memo. Notion Product Updates.

• **Meta:** Llama 4 405B (Open Weights) is now available on Hugging Face with a 1M token context window and 89.5% MMLU. It is the first open-source model to match frontier closed-source reasoning while supporting 4-bit quantization for local deployment. Developers can now run a state-of-the-art reasoning model on a local 80GB H100 node for fully private, offline data processing. Hugging Face Blog.

Why it matters: The transition from "AI as a chatbot" to "AI as an autonomous OS" is now complete, with frontier models shifting toward local deployment and cross-app agency.
